title: Food Bank Shift Fill Rate
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`community:shift`), donations (`community:donation`), mutual-aid requests (`community:mutualaid`), service ops (`community:impact`).
app: Community-service telemetry — food-bank shift logs, blood-donation records, and mutual-aid request maps — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=community:shift shift_role=* filled=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(filled="yes",1,0))) as matched by shift_role
| eval a_filled_shift_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_filled_shift_pct
description: Measures the percentage of food-bank shifts that end with a filled shift by shift role.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which shift role are helping or hurting food-bank shifts.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a filled shift` on `community:shift` events and summarize the hit rate by `shift_role`.
visualization: Table of shift role with percentage of food-bank shifts ending with a filled shift.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how often a filled shift happens for each shift role so you can see where food-bank shifts go smoothly or get stuck.
